Request beta access

Opens your email app. Requesting information does not confirm access or compatibility. macOS is not available.

Before installing

  1. Request the exact filename, SHA-256, byte length and requirements for the supplied build.
  2. Verify the file and publisher. Keep Windows protections enabled.
  3. Use a supported writable local installation folder and workspace. Follow the supplied build’s location and maintenance instructions.
  4. Check current host/connector compatibility separately. Installed software does not mean it is connected.
  5. Keep the exact error if setup fails. Preserve your workspace before repair, rollback or uninstall.
